description: List this company's requests to add brands (usually competitors) to the Sequenzy email gallery, newest first. Each has a status: requested (not added yet), collecting (the brand is added and its emails are being collected), available (its emails are in the gallery; brand.url links to them and list_email_references can return them) or declined (with declineReason). Requires templates:read.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: list_gallery_brand_requests

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_gallery_brand_requests` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

limit.description: How many requests a company can keep.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

requests.description: Brand requests, newest first: id, domain, note, status (requested, collecting, available or declined), declineReason, requestedAt and brand (name, slug and url, once its emails are in the gallery).

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
